It has over 300 of my favorite restaurants, cafes, bakeries, rooftop bars, and hidden gems, all organized inside Google Maps. Imagine it's lunchtime, you're hungry, instead of searching TikTok again or walking 30 minutes across the city, you simply open Google Maps and instantly find one of my favorite restaurants just a few minutes away. Everything is already organized for you so you spend less time searching and more time actually enjoying Barcelona. Because you didn't fly all the way to Spain just to eat at a restaurant with pictures on the menu. Don't waste your vacation trying to figure out where to go.
